description: The Body of Christ in motion, read only: the map, today's activity, testimonies, worship, sermons, live church services, Living Rooms, songs, games. Example: {mode:"sermons"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/see_the_kingdom. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

language.description: For worship, songs, videos, sermons. BCP-47 language code.

local_hour.description: For worship: the person's local hour, 0 to 23. Defaults to the current UTC hour.

mode.description: The kind of answer. Leave out for a guide to the modes.

mood.description: For worship: one word for how they are, e.g. "weary", "thankful".

query.description: For songs: a title or an author, e.g. "grace", "Newton".

topic.description: For sermons: one topic word the church tagged, e.g. "hope", "prayer".

word.description: For testimonies: one word to find in excerpts or journey labels, e.g. "addiction", "grief".
